name: Outfitter
description: Install it and you have a merch store. No theme, no build.

images.title: A finished store, before you touch it
images.description: Installs rendering its own pages — header, hero, navigation and catalog — with nothing to configure first.

images.title: Pages built from sections
images.description: Seventeen section types arranged in the editor: the product grid, three across, above an image and text block.

images.title: Product options, variant and not
images.description: Size and colour resolve the variant; text, toggle and select options ride along to the cart.

images.title: Category pages that keep their products
images.description: Every page keeps the section it exists for, with marketing sections arranged above and below it.
